lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Reward: Stethoscope ×2

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Thank you, Commander.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I didn't expect you to give me over 50%!
You did right by me, so I'll do right by you.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: It was nothing, really.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: It was just my way of thanking you.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Actually, having too much money can be a bad thing in these parts.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Since there's no law to protect us here,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: power is the ultimate currency.
Are you in any danger?

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: There is no safe place in the Outer Rim,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: but I'm safe enough for now.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I'm able to afford protection.
Protection?

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: As I said,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: power supersedes everything in the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: A group of thugs controls the area where I live,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: but if I pay them off, they don't bother me.
They may end up changing their minds one day.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: You're right,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: but not today.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: I can survive another day.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: That's how life is here.
Is there anything I can do?

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: You must hear this all the time,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: but you truly are a good person, Commander.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Thank you for everything you've done,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: but as your Nikkes have told you,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: bad things happen when you associate with people from the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: You came to my aid when I needed it most

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: and I returned the favor the only way I knew how.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: In a sense, you could say we're even now.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Take care of yourself,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: and I'll do the same.
Farewell, friend.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: If the time ever comes when you need my help,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: just call for me,

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: and I'll do everything I can.
Deal.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: So long.

lines.speaker: collector
lines.text: Have a nice life!
